name: Put/call SPIKE velocity with fear crash confluence (fresh consensus panic, long)
rationale: MECHANISM: velocity-flavored options-capitulation spec. Instead of a standing extreme put/call level, it triggers on put/call CROSSING UP through a fitted spike (a fresh surge in downside hedging — professionals scrambling for protection RIGHT NOW) confirmed by fear_greed also crossing DOWN (retail panic breaking simultaneously). Fresh, synchronized informed+retail panic marks the moment forced flow is heaviest and the over-hedge is most extreme; the subsequent unwind is the buy pressure. Distinct from the static put/call-fear confluence (hh-14) because it reads the SPEED of the hedging surge, and distinct from the fear-only velocity spec because it adds the informed options channel. Long; exit when put/call normalizes or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER: verify putcall_ratio per-symbol coverage FIRST (BTC/ETH-only, short history) — thin N dies at the Gate. If the put/call CROSS carries no independent sign once you control for its LEVEL and for fear_greed, the velocity framing is redundant — kill.
catalyst: a fresh put/call hedging surge as retail fear breaks down
